title: HPLC Analysts
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Conduct HPLC analysis of Finished Goods (FG) samples to ensure compliance with quality standards.
 Perform Quality Check on FG samples using HPLC techniques to detect any defects or impurities.
 Ensure accurate recording of test results, data entry into databases, and timely reporting.

Key Skills: HPLC Analysis,HPLC,FG,QC,Finished Goods,Quality Check,Quality Control,Analysts
